notes.title: Game Update CONVOLUTED INCIDENT: PINCH ME
notes.content:
Friends! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33369575]Gamesforfarm[/url] team is pleased to announce an update to the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107990/Zaputannaya_istoriya_ushhipni_menya/]CONVOLUTED INCIDENT: PINCH ME[/url].

What's new?
We added several new locations and updated the ending in the hospital.

We hope that you will appreciate the update and leave your positive feedback about the game.
